title: Verify a Recruiter
subtitle: Paste a recruiter's email, link, or message. We'll check it against the company's hiring.txt declaration — everything runs in your browser.

company.label: Company Name
company.hint: We'll look this up in our registry to find the canonical domain.

senderEmail.label: Sender Email
senderEmail.hint: The email address the recruiter contacted you from.

listingUrl.label: Job Listing URL
listingUrl.hint: Optional. The job listing or application link they sent.

messageText.label: Message Text
messageText.placeholder: Paste the recruiter's message here for scam language analysis...
messageText.hint: Optional. We scan for payment requests, urgency language, crypto references, and other red flags.

authHeader.label: Email Authentication Header
authHeader.hint: Optional. Paste the Authentication-Results header from the email source to check DKIM/SPF/DMARC.

canonicalDomain.label: Canonical Domain
canonicalDomain.hint: If the company isn't in our registry, enter their official domain manually.

registry.notFound: Company not in registry — enter canonical domain manually

result.title: Verification Result

verdictDesc.VERIFIED: The recruiter's information matches the company's hiring.txt declaration. This is a hard, deterministic match.
verdictDesc.UNKNOWN: We couldn't verify this recruiter — the company may not have a hiring.txt, or the information didn't match. This is not evidence of fraud.
verdictDesc.SUSPICIOUS: Warning signs detected. Proceed with caution and verify through official company channels.
verdictDesc.VERIFIED_CONTRADICTION: Domain verification passed but a Never commitment is contradicted. This may indicate account compromise.

result.action_VERIFIED: This appears legitimate. You can proceed with the recruitment process through the channels listed in their hiring.txt.
result.action_UNKNOWN: Contact the company directly through their official website to confirm this recruiter's identity before sharing any personal information.
result.action_SUSPICIOUS: Do NOT respond to this recruiter. Report the suspicious contact to the company using their Report-Abuse channel and to local authorities if money was requested.

corsBlocked.title: CORS Blocked
corsBlocked.desc: The company's server doesn't allow cross-origin requests. The file may exist but we can't fetch it from the browser.
corsBlocked.suggestion: Try the browser extension (coming soon) for CORS-independent verification, or manually check:
